description: One column on a phone: Bookmarks' settings page at 375x812 with touch and jellyfin-web's mobile layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'mobile'), run by bookmarks-settings-probe.mjs. On each tab (Settings, Data, Diagnostics) the page is no wider than the screen, with no element or text outside a table's box past its right edge (a long path breaks); every table (the snapshots, the per-user counts with their 11 columns, the client health list) sits in its own box inside the screen, which scrolls sideways when the table is wider. A screenshot of the Data and the Diagnostics tabs. The layout is per browser, and each run has a fresh profile.

steps.name: how the page is measured: its width, each table's box, any element or text past the screen's right edge outside a box
steps.script: window.__jfbmPhone = () => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const W = innerWidth; const box = (b) => { const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return { table: b.firstElementChild.className.replace('bookmarksTable ', ''), left: Math.round(r.left), right: Math.round(r.right), tableWidth: Math.round(b.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width), scrolls: b.scrollWidth > b.clientWidth }; }; const wide = [...p.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e => e.getClientRects().length > 0 && !e.closest('.bookmarksTableScroll') && Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().right) > W).slice(0, 5).map(e => e.tagName + '#' + e.id + '.' + e.className); const texts = []; const walker = document.createTreeWalker(p, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let n; while ((n = walker.nextNode())) { if (!n.textContent.trim() || n.parentElement.closest('.bookmarksTableScroll')) continue; const range = document.createRange(); range.selectNodeContents(n); const r = range.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width > 0 && Math.round(r.right) > W) texts.push({ text: n.textContent.slice(0, 40), right: Math.round(r.right) }); } return { width: W, page: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, boxes: [...p.querySelectorAll('.bookmarksTableScroll')].filter(b => b.getClientRects().length > 0).map(box), counts: !!p.querySelector('#BookmarksCounts table.bookmarksCountsTable'), wide, texts: texts.slice(0, 5) }; }; return true;

steps.name: Settings: the page fits the screen
Data: the page fits the screen; the snapshots' table is in its box, inside the screen
Diagnostics: the page fits the screen; the counts' table (when a user has bookmarks) is in its box, inside the screen, and the box scrolls the wider table
steps.assert: __vars.diagnostics.page <= __vars.diagnostics.width && __vars.diagnostics.wide.length === 0 && __vars.diagnostics.texts.length === 0 && __vars.diagnostics.boxes.every(b => b.left >= 0 && b.right <= __vars.diagnostics.width) && (!__vars.diagnostics.counts || __vars.diagnostics.boxes.some(b => b.table === 'bookmarksCountsTable' && b.scrolls === (b.tableWidth > b.right - b.left)))

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider while JE's Custom Tabs sync runs, excepted)
